name: @deterministic-code/typescript-generators
description: TypeScript generator pack for the deterministic toolchain: the emit-*-typescript lane modules + frontend/client/zod helpers.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R src/templates dist/ && cp src/sdk/default-settings.yaml dist/sdk/
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/generate-backend-app.integration.test.ts src/generate-frontend-app.integration.test.ts src/generate-datasource-types.integration.test.ts src/generate-datasource-types-tests.integration.test.ts src/generate-datasource-type-validators.integration.test.ts src/generate-datasource-type-validators-tests.integration.test.ts src/generate-view-types.integration.test.ts src/generate-view-types-tests.integration.test.ts src/generate-view-type-validators.integration.test.ts src/generate-view-type-validators-tests.integration.test.ts src/generate-services.integration.test.ts src/generate-routes.integration.test.ts src/common/parse-datasource-types.test.ts src/common/parse-view-types.test.ts src/common/parse-services.test.ts src/common/parse-routes.test.ts
